packageRules.description: Group the shared toolchain (catalog) into one PR.
Automerge patch + minor devDependency updates once CI passes.
Automerge patch updates for runtime deps once CI passes.
Automerge pnpm / packageManager bumps once CI passes.

Hold pnpm majors until opted into by hand. 11.18.0's standalone binary (@pnpm/macos-arm64, @pnpm/linux-x64) is published without the dist/ it loads, so `pnpm install` dies with ENOENT locally — while CI stays green, because pnpm/action-setup installs the complete npm package instead. CI cannot catch this class of break, so it must not automerge.
